name: Inflection Live-Portal Data Drift Remediation
description: Andrew-flagged URGENT 2026-05-15: Inflection live-portal numbers drifted after the 17:57Z full chain (Segment Analytics WA count 685 -> 744; visible slippage between snapshot / radial / header). DS~A + DE 0.4 co-investigated; BE root-caused, all evidence-backed (S3 object-versions + INF_D_04 code). TWO distinct defect clusters: (A) INF_D_04 client_portal_summary.py geo-view + histogram-block count-reconciliation defects -- null-city accounts dropped from the city breakdown so state != sum(city); the histogram 1K floor emits no excluded-count so plotted != total; client_count has a dual source of truth (geo-derived 321 vs accounts_dim 307); radial_12m partial decomposition is unlabeled. (B) the 06:00 daily cron SYSTEMATICALLY under-builds gold/canonical/holdings_{date}.parquet -- CHAIN_INCREMENTAL omits INF_B_00 (canonical_holdings), so the portal serves short-holdings numbers most of every day until an on-demand full chain runs (the 17:57Z full chain corrected 2026-05-15; 2026-05-14 showed the same pattern). Note: 744 is CORRECT, 685 was the regression -- the drift was a defective 06:00 build being corrected, not a methodology change; INF_D_04 code is unchanged since 2026-05-14.
